old_power.dtn_port_modal_reference: top=physical_z_max; bottom=physical_z_min; bottom lossy power uses boundary-plane phase attenuation
old_power.dtn_port_modal_amplitude_convention: auxiliary unknown a_j is the total-field port projection. top outgoing amplitude = a_j - incident_projection_j; bottom outgoing amplitude = a_j. Power uses boundary-plane outgoing amplitude after applying boundary_phase.
old_power.dtn_port_power_metric_note: Stage-4 dtn_port R/T is computed directly from auxiliary outgoing modal amplitudes on the finite top and bottom port faces. Selected modes with positive outward real-Poynting flux contribute even when a below-critical lossy mode retains propagating=false; lossless evanescent modes carry zero modal power.
